aha.title: It does not need to know everything to start helping.
aha.desc: xopc starts with the context you choose to share, explains its understanding, and finds the most credible next step.
aha.ariaLabel: Example of xopc turning an unfinished thought into a next step
aha.userMessage: I want to launch this project next week, but I have been avoiding it and I am not sure where to restart.
contextItems: Two decisions are still waiting for review
The last project update was 12 days ago
aha.assistantMessage: You do not need to finish everything tonight. The release is blocked by one decision, so that is the smallest credible place to restart.
aha.nextStep: Review the two open decisions and choose which one must be resolved before the release checklist can continue.

capabilities.title: Local-first
capabilities.body: Core state and the Gateway run in your environment.

capabilities.title: Model freedom
capabilities.body: Connect your provider and choose cloud or local models for each task.

capabilities.title: Act, then verify
capabilities.body: Use Skills, Workflows, and Automations to move work forward and verify results.

capabilities.title: Continue anywhere
capabilities.body: Carry the same state across desktop, web, terminal, mobile, and messaging apps.

trust.title: Visible understanding. Explicit control.
trust.desc: See what xopc based a decision on, then decide what it can access and what it can do.

items.title: Local-first by default
items.body: Core state lives in your xopc environment. When you use a cloud model, the request context you send is processed by that provider.

items.title: Sources stay permissioned
items.body: Connect data sources separately and decide what each agent or task is allowed to use.

items.title: Consequential actions pause
items.body: Sending, deleting, purchasing, and other high-impact actions return to you for confirmation.

items.title: Memory remains correctable
items.body: Review, correct, or remove durable understanding when it is wrong, outdated, or no longer useful.

trust.factExample: The release checklist has not changed in 12 days.
trust.inferenceExample: You may be blocked by an unresolved product decision.
trust.correctionNote: Facts and inferences stay distinct. You can correct either before it becomes durable understanding.

gateway.name: xopc Gateway
gateway.metaTitle: xopc Gateway | Make a local AI runtime a connected service
gateway.metaDescription: Connect a local xopc runtime to web, mobile, messaging channels, and APIs while keeping control of configuration, identity, and data boundaries.
gateway.desc: xopc Gateway brings the agents, state, and workflows running in your environment to web, mobile, messaging channels, and APIs. It is a unified entry point—not another isolated backend.

quickStart.title: Run your local runtime as a service.
quickStart.desc: Install xopc, start Gateway, then hand it to your operating system when it should run continuously.

steps.label: Install
steps.title: Install xopc
steps.body: The cross-platform installer prepares the dependencies required to run it.

steps.label: Start
steps.title: Start Gateway
steps.body: Start the web server and local React console.

steps.label: Serve
steps.title: Install the system service
steps.body: Let Gateway run continuously through the operating system service lifecycle.

flow.kicker: From local runtime to service entry point
flow.title: Run once. Connect from many places.
flow.desc: Gateway exposes a running xopc instance as a controlled entry point, so clients and channels share the same state and execution capability.

steps.title: Run the runtime
steps.body: Start xopc in an environment you own, retaining local configuration, data, and provider choices.

steps.title: Connect surfaces
steps.body: Configure web, mobile, messaging channels, or other enabled client entry points.

steps.title: Serve clients
steps.body: Use Gateway APIs and streaming connections for clients to access sessions, tasks, and runtime status.

steps.title: Operate continuously
steps.body: Observe service and channel status so the local runtime can operate as a durable service.

capabilities.title: Put connection capability in one place.
capabilities.desc: Gateway provides a unified service layer for xopc clients, channels, and integrations, avoiding separate state and auth maintenance for every surface.

items.title: One service entry point
items.body: Let web, mobile, and other clients connect to one local runtime instead of duplicating agent state.

items.title: Gateway APIs and streams
items.body: Expose service interfaces for sessions, tasks, state, and real-time updates.

items.title: Channel runtimes
items.body: Load and manage messaging channel runtimes while keeping those conversation surfaces connected to core agent capability.

items.title: Service lifecycle
items.body: Manage the local Gateway around start, status, restart, and system-service operation.

items.title: Bring one runtime to more devices
items.body: Let web, mobile, desktop, and other surfaces see the same sessions, projects, and execution state.

items.title: Connect agents to messaging surfaces
items.body: Let people start and receive the same agent work through connected messaging channels.

items.title: Provide a backend for custom clients
items.body: Use APIs and streaming interfaces to bring xopc capability into existing products or internal tools.

items.title: Run continuously as a service
items.body: Keep a local AI runtime available over a manageable service lifecycle.

trust.kicker: The service remains in your control
trust.title: Connect more surfaces without giving up the boundary.
items: Local operation: start Gateway around your own device, configuration, and runtime environment.
Unified state: clients and channels connect to one runtime instead of scattered copies.
Operability: inspect service and channel status, then manage the lifecycle when needed.

cross.title: Need an agent to complete a concrete computer task?
cross.desc: xopc Desktop brings the runtime behind Gateway into everyday work that can be delegated and confirmed.

desktop.name: xopc Desktop
desktop.metaTitle: xopc Desktop | A cross-platform desktop agent
desktop.metaDescription: An Electron desktop agent for Windows, macOS, and Linux that plans, acts, confirms, and delivers work in your local environment.
desktop.desc: xopc Desktop is a cross-platform agent app that runs on your desktop. It understands the goal, uses web and tools available on your machine, and returns control before consequential actions.

flow.title: Move work all the way forward in your local environment.
flow.desc: The desktop app is more than a few automated clicks. It turns desktop work into a process you can understand, inspect, and resume.

steps.title: Start on the desktop
steps.body: Describe what needs to move forward and what a useful result looks like.

steps.title: See the plan
steps.body: Review the breakdown in the desktop app, then add context or boundaries when needed.

steps.title: Use local tools
steps.body: The agent uses allowed web and tools to progress, then stops when a decision belongs to you.

steps.title: Confirm and deliver
steps.body: Receive the result and its record, with a clear next step instead of a one-off chat.

capabilities.kicker: A desktop app, not another chat window
capabilities.title: One app, connected to your real work environment.
capabilities.desc: Connect web, files, information entry points, and durable workflows from your desktop to one observable agent runtime.

items.title: Cross-platform desktop app
items.body: Built with Electron for Windows, macOS, and Linux, so every work machine has one consistent entry point.

items.title: Local environment execution
items.body: Move work from the desktop into web, files, and connected tools available on your machine.

items.title: Execution you can see
items.body: Organize an objective into trackable steps instead of forcing complex work into one prompt.

items.title: Human in the loop
items.body: Keep decisions, authorizations, and sending actions that matter with you.

scenarios.title: Work worth handing to xopc Desktop.

items.title: Research and decision preparation
items.body: Gather information from multiple sources and turn it into notes, a table, or grounded next steps.

items.title: Recurring back-office work
items.body: Turn a fixed process into observable tasks, taking over only at exceptions or key decisions.

items.title: Status synthesis and weekly updates
items.body: Shape scattered progress, source material, and todos into a deliverable that can keep evolving.

items.title: Cross-app personal tasks
items.body: Let a goal travel through everyday tools instead of being trapped in a chat window.

trust.title: Visible, controllable, and yours.
items: Local-first: you control the data, keys, and runtime environment.
Visible process: know what the agent is doing and where it is waiting.
Clear boundaries: return high-impact actions to a person for confirmation.

cross.title: Need an agent to change a local codebase?
cross.desc: xopc Terminal organizes coding agents, project workspaces, change review, and verification records into another complete delivery path.

desktopDownload.title: Download xopc for desktop.
desktopDownload.desc: For Windows, macOS, and Linux. We’ll recommend the installer that matches this device first.

terminal.name: xopc Terminal
terminal.metaTitle: xopc Terminal | Powerful coding agents from your terminal
terminal.metaDescription: Run xopc in a project directory to use powerful coding agents and their harness, with built-in Codebase Memory and the freedom to switch to non-coding agents in the terminal.
terminal.desc: Run xopc from a project directory to use powerful coding agents and their harness for understanding, changing, and verifying a real codebase. Built-in Codebase Memory makes code queryable; when the task is not coding, switch agents in the same terminal and keep moving.
terminalPoints: Run xopc in your project directory
Switch to other agents when needed

quickStart.title: Start agent work from your terminal.
quickStart.desc: Install xopc, connect the agent you prefer, then code—or switch to another task—from a local project directory.

steps.label: Install
steps.title: Install the xopc CLI
steps.body: For developers who already have a Node.js environment.

steps.label: Connect
steps.title: Complete provider onboarding
steps.body: Connect Codex, Claude Code, or the coding capability you choose during setup.

steps.label: Start
steps.title: Run xopc in your terminal
steps.body: Invoke a coding agent in the project directory, then switch agents when the task changes.

flow.title: Make coding-agent work a reviewable loop.
flow.desc: The point is not how much code appears at once; it is understanding, changing, validating, and handing off a real project responsibly.

steps.title: Invoke from the project
steps.body: Build task-relevant project context from the terminal, request, and local workspace.

steps.title: Propose a plan
steps.body: Clarify the implementation path, impact area, and required verification before editing.

steps.title: Advance with the harness
steps.body: Use connected coding agents to make changes, repair issues, and call the tools needed in the workspace.

steps.title: Review and verify
steps.body: Use the diff, commands, and verification results to show what changed and what deserves attention.

capabilities.title: Powerful for coding—and not limited to it.
capabilities.desc: xopc Terminal gives coding agents task structure, project context, and a delivery harness in the terminal. Codebase Memory makes code structure, relationships, and impact scope queryable; switch agents directly when the task is not coding.

items.title: A powerful coding-agent harness
items.body: Organize context, plans, tool calls, changes, diffs, and verification around a real codebase, so an agent can drive a complete delivery rather than emit isolated snippets.

items.title: Codebase Memory
items.body: Use a built-in code knowledge graph for functions, types, call chains, routes, and cross-service relationships—then combine semantic search, structural queries, and impact analysis to find relevant code quickly.

items.title: Switch agents in the terminal
items.body: Beyond coding, switch from the same entry point to an agent suited for research, synthesis, operations, or everyday tasks.

items.title: Trackable changes
items.body: Organize code changes, executed commands, and verification results into a record people can review.

scenarios.title: Work worth handing to xopc Terminal.

items.title: From issue to implementation plan
items.body: Understand the request and impact area before receiving a reviewable path to implementation.

items.title: Bug investigation and repair
items.body: Trace a problem in the real repository, make the fix, and return the verification result.

items.title: Refactoring and test coverage
items.body: Break structural change into verifiable steps to reduce the risk of changing code without checking outcomes.

items.title: Move from coding to another task
items.body: Switch agents from the same terminal when research, synthesis, or everyday work needs to continue beyond the codebase.

trust.title: Give every change a basis.
items: Your workspace: work around local projects and established tools.
Your choice: connect different coding agents—or switch to another agent—for the task.
Your review: use changes and verification records to decide whether to accept delivery.

cross.title: Need an agent to progress everyday computer work?
cross.desc: xopc Desktop organizes goals, tool execution, approvals, and durable state into a delivery path for real-world tasks.

loop.desc: xopc captures the input, connects the relevant context, acts and verifies within your boundaries, then keeps the next step ready.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Start with text, voice, a file, a link, or an unfinished thought. You do not need to organize it first.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Connect the input to the people, projects, decisions, and constraints that matter.

steps.title: Act and verify
steps.body: Take the smallest capable path, use allowed tools, and keep evidence of what changed.

steps.title: Continue
steps.body: Keep the next action and follow-up together so the work can resume without starting over.
